newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Wegener expects 10 pct EPS growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Wegener expects 10 pct EPS growth in 1997.

text.p: Dutch publisher Wegener NV said on Wednesday it expected to see an increase in 1997 earnings per share of at least 10 percent.

The company earlier posted 1996 net profit of 69.4 million guilders ($36.8 million), up from 58.7 million one year earlier. In August it said it expected profit growth in the second half of 1996 to match the 16.1 percent growth of the first half. ($ = 1.885 Dutch Guilders)
